newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish government clears Kopex trader sale.
newsitem.headline: Polish government clears Kopex trader sale.

text.p: The Polish government on Tuesday approved a plan to privatise large mining machinery trader Kopex SA, the government press office said in a statement.
It said the plan provided for a public offer of at least 25 percent of Kopex shares and earmarking a 15 percent stake for the company's employees.
The sale will be designed to select several industrial and financial investors in the company through a public tender, it said.

"Selecting one strategic investor which would take over a controlling stake will not be allowed because of the size of the company's capital, the sector in which it operates, its turnover and estimated value," it said.
Kopex' turnover reached 100 million last year. The government statement did not provide any more financial data on the company.
